pr.title: Show the inbox list and an opened pull request one at a time on phones
pr.body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"jasondwhyte"} -->
_Requested by **Jason** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01YGtEMFvZnSp5cxW5MGErkd?thread=cmsg_01YGtEMFvZnSp5cxW5MGErkdAuTTXAUiYqL8WeK5kjWt5y)_

Before: on a phone, the inbox squeezed the pull request list and the opened pull request side by side, so both were cramped.

After: on phone-sized screens (narrower than 768px, the same point where the menu switches to its phone version) the list fills the screen. Tapping a pull request opens it full width with an "All pull requests" button at the top to go back. Laptops and desktops keep the two-panel layout exactly as before.

How: `App` uses Astryx's `useMediaQuery("(width < 768px)")` and a `showingPr` flag. Choosing a pull request (from the list, a loop, a finding or a notification) sets it; the back button, the "All pull requests" menu item and Ctrl/Cmd+K clear it. `Detail` gains an optional `onBack` prop that shows the back button, matching the existing back buttons on the Loops and Findings pages. On phones the list only highlights a pull request you actually opened, and if the opened one disappears (merged or closed) you land back on the list instead of on a different pull request.

Checks: two new tests (phone one-at-a-time, desktop side-by-side), full `vitest` suite (187 passing), eslint, prettier and `tsc -b`. Also checked in a real browser at 390px and 1400px wide.

commit.message:
Show the inbox list and an opened pull request one at a time on phones

Below the mobile menu breakpoint the inbox and the opened pull request no
longer squeeze side by side. The list fills the screen; tapping a pull
request opens it with an "All pull requests" button to go back. Wider
screens keep the two-panel layout.
